purpose: Define the order and gates required for a genuinely held-out method-v2 campaign after using R39 only as development/audit evidence.
design_set_forever: R28 M1--M9 and all target-gate-suppression outcomes
R29 H01--H03 definitions and invalid-run diagnostics
R30 F1--F3 definitions and executor-review findings
R35 historical alias mechanism and all eight coordinate outcomes
R39 BF01--BF11 definitions, feasibility decisions, and outcomes

fields: complete-vocabulary contiguous CPU-FP32 logits with shape/dtype binding
paired_semantic_differential.attribution: conventional paired semantic baseline, reported separately from structural ForkAudit

hybrid_atomic_version_coherence.predicate: exactly one scheduled commit publishes both KV and GDN under one commit_id; neither subsystem may independently advance, roll back, or publish

freeze_sequence: freeze revised contract/PDF and all v2 detector, replay, schema, threshold, capture, and clean-package bytes
pass local unit/static/full clean replay and H20 clean-only smoke
write immutable detector-v2 preregistration with hashes before spawning the fault designer
spawn a fresh isolated designer with only revised public contract/PDF, fixed geometry, and injection adapter interface
freeze exactly eight fault rows plus selectors, eligibility, horizons, injection witnesses, and no-expected-gate policy
independent executor freezes mappings and preexecution eligibility without changing v2 predicates
run eight matched reference-clean-mutant rows once on eight distinct H20s
detached scorer retains all outcomes and reports every observer separately

designer_must_not_see: detector source or private predicate implementation
reviewer comments or author revision plan

formal_h20_one_shot.assignment: one frozen row per distinct GPU
formal_h20_one_shot.output_root_policy: must not exist; atomic writes; no overwrite
formal_h20_one_shot.rerun_policy: no selective retry; a pre-output operational amendment requires a new package and full new campaign ID; any post-output change creates v3 and retains v2
required_preflight: exact detector-v2, fault-set, executor, scorer, model, data, runtime, and launcher hashes
all local tests and source ledgers pass
clean-only H20 gate passes before fault-set execution

feasibility_evidence.interpretation: same-stack precedent only; not a v2 runtime guarantee
